initialization: Original selected complete-predictor final weights; preserve selected architecture, width, normalization and root-LP features
optimizer: Original Adam API and defaults, fresh empty optimizer state; reset is disclosed, not a resumed optimizer state
batching: Original shuffled epoch convention: batch16,16,4 over all36 costs, repeated until exactly2000 optimizer updates
final_checkpoint: Only the fixed checkpoint after update2000; no best checkpoint or validation/test selection
partial_resume: No mid-run resume. Failed attempts retained and deterministic restart uses original weights plus fixed case-derived batch seed.
resource_plan: At most4 single-thread CPU workers in the root-coordinated shared queue; no cloud
validation_plan: After all3 final controlled checkpoints are frozen, use a new independent paired second stream for Ours, originalND and continuedND. No first-stream outcome selects a checkpoint.
